<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Inflation and Growth:</strong> India&#x27;s June retail inflation hit 4.38%, exceeding the RBI’s 4% target for the first time in 18 months, while the central bank maintains the repo rate and projects a 6.9% real GDP growth for the fiscal year.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTFBaODgwazNxbDNqYWdONFl6WnBvOUhEVmdReGdxR1ozS245dmszWXpLZUJvNWNPdk1ucmcwNmF3dW56N2tsWnQtQWFULVZLMm1oZldTeTcwTzdrUzFrb1dkSm5IR0pnajdpazJxZmJBeklfdUFXeGRhN0pvLXI?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOTGFSNzg0VzlJdnMwYWh2TzliX3libXhnd0pFajdsbW05R3dZU3Y5V3BjRU5uV2Q0aDVOZWZNX3dDdHpvNXpGOXRTQlNnQVRScklzNU5QdjVmV2YzOWlFVWZXMXFSZWxscFJIdFY0UHhleHZreWhkRmhqNGpCeTBYTVlpZ3AxcFN5X0h6SkFqSHJzSTBhWER6N1lkQXB3cnlLRXU4TF95ZjNWdC01XzBkTm0zOGN3RmpXc1lQSkdR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Volatility:</strong> Domestic indices opened lower, with the Sensex dropping over 500 points as investors react to rising crude oil prices and inflationary pressures.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google._?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory Action:</strong> The Supreme Court has upheld SEBI’s ₹2.1 crore penalty against Kotak AMC and its executives regarding past Fixed Maturity Plan (FMP) rule violations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Geopolitical Impact on Commodities:</strong> Renewed US-Iran tensions have pushed Brent crude prices above $85 per barrel, triggering a negative sentiment across Indian markets and the GIFT Nifty.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxPVU0wckU5THQ0RzVCTy1PQ3E0WUdjaUlYY09mcm56WVdlWFRnWUJqd3otWXFuTVJqeWpySXJla3lzNEJFalNRdGROelhKaDlRV202VHZCeUxWXzg4aVBFN2N6R2dOYk03TV9GSG9RUGNWMGZWek9teURPdUhZZ3d1UTBuOUtFaUNDRm5LUUN3eW94R0tYM3pDVFJvZFNxcmdKUFlsekM4TkMzUFZjYVJ4cUtiWlJ4T2xORWhvbktn?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Bond Yields and Currency:</strong> The Indian rupee has come under pressure, contributing to a 4 bps surge in the 10-year bond yield to 6.77% as markets navigate global volatility.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
